5-8-602: - EAST KUNA INDUSTRIAL OVERLAY DISTRICT:
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT5KUDERECO_CH8ZOCO_PT6OVDI_5-8-602EAKUINOVDI","Title":"5-8-602: - EAST KUNA INDUSTRIAL OVERLAY DISTRICT:","Content":"
\n

\n A.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Purpose and intent.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 1.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n The East Kuna Industrial Overlay District is intended to provide for large scale industrial\n development accommodating more intensive uses than found near the city core.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n B.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Applicability.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 1.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n The East Kuna Industrial Overlay District is hereby established for land within the\n incorporated City Limits of the City of Kuna and any land outside the City Limits\n for which annexation has been requested as shown on the adopted East Kuna Industrial\n Overlay District Map.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n C.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n General Standards within the East Kuna Industrial Overlay District.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 1.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n If a conflict should arise between the provisions of this section and other chapters\n of this title, the provisions of this section shall prevail.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 2.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Sidewalks. The sidewalk shall be constructed in accordance with KCC 5-10-13-B. Deferment\n of sidewalk development is permitted and will require the applicant to enter into\n an agreement detailing at what point in time sidewalks will be required to be installed\n onsite.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 3.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Landscaping Standards.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n a.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n The landscape shall incorporate a water conserving design and be consistent with the\n natural vegetation coverage of the high desert climate.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n b.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Whenever possible, existing vegetation coverage shall be utilized in place of new\n trees, plants and shrubs.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n c.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n New landscape installation should consist of native drought resistant planting.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n d.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Boulders, rocks and other hard ground covers are encouraged in place of lawn and turf.\n If installed, lawn and turf areas shall not comprise more than twenty-five (25) percent\n of the total landscaped areas and shall consist of water conserving grasses, including\n but not limited to, Buffalo Grass, Blue Gamma Grass, Compact Fescue, Zerilawn, and/or\n Rhyzomotuous Tall Fescue.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 4.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Fencing Standards.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n a.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Fences not to exceed ten (10) feet in height, may be located or maintained on any\n property line except within vision clearance areas.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n b.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Barbed wire may be permitted when used as the top section for security fences, provided\n barbed wires are a minimum seventy-two (72) inched above grade and do not project\n over public right-of-way.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n c.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Exceptional height or materials may be approved on a case-by-case basis by the Planning\n and Zoning Commission at the recommendation of the Director or their designee.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n (Ord. No. 2024-06, § 2, 4-16-2024)\n
